funds_data.description: The fund is a fund of funds that invests at least 80% of its total assets in the constituents of the index. The index consists of up to 25 equally-weighted equity ETFs that demonstrate positive cash flow. When the cash flow trends are negative, a portion or all of the index consists of one or more treasury ETFs.
